sarah: quick postmortem follow-up (INC-2026-0912). Recurring latency spikes during autoscaler flapping + KV invalidation. need temporary SLO change + owners.
sarah: propose p95 150ms -> 220ms for 4 weeks, with 72h checkpoint and 2-week review. rollback if p95 < 165ms for 7 days.
anna (SRE): agree. also shrink throughput evaluation window 60s -> 30s during temp window to avoid hitting error budget on short spikes.
jun: i'll own dashboards and runbook. will add p95, p99, QPS by pool, and canary annotations. sample PromQL for p95 by pool: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))
```
jun: PR will include a 99p panel and an alert for p99 > 400ms.
mike: i'll take autoscaler tuning and canary. plan: smooth scale-up, increase cool-down, staged rollout across pools. canary in 3 days. abort if p99 > 450ms for 10m.
sre-bot: created follow-up ticket INC-2026-0912-FOLLOWUP (#4702) and linked postmortem.
sarah: action list (please ack): - Dashboard + runbook (48h): jun - Canary/autoscaler (start in 3d): mike - Kernel perf probe (2w): anna - Customer comms draft (72h): sarah - SLO governance update (5d): sarah
jun: ack (dashboard PR #1103).
mike: ack (canary plan in #4702).
anna (SRE): ack (kernel probe ticket #4705).
sarah: thanks all. i'll hold comms until 72h checkpoint unless canary shows user-facing regressions. please drop one-line "owned" after PR/ticket links so i can close assignments in #4702. :thumbsup:
